_note: The signed SOW as a PDF in the NetSuite file cabinet. NetSuite exposes NO join from a document to a project - the attachment tables are not queryable through SuiteQL, and a custom 'SOW link' entity field usually holds a Google Drive URL rather than a file cabinet id. So these are matched by FILE NAME against your contract folders. conf 1 = the file names the client and the SOW number and nothing else competes. conf 0 = a candidate the name did not settle; the console renders it as an amber 'pdf?' with the note in its tooltip, so nobody reads a guess as the contract. Jobs absent from this map simply get no pdf link. Sample data - the ids, hashes and folder numbers are invented.
